package handler

import (
	"context"
	"io"
	"log"
	"net/http"

	"github.com/aws/aws-sdk-go-v2/service/s3"
)

// scenario for s3_getobject_without_range: `s3.GetObject` downloading full objects when only partial data is needed (inferred from subsequent `io.LimitReader` or partial reads)
// fixture polarity: positive; family: library; severity: warning.
func DownloadHandler(s3Client *s3.Client, bucket, key string) http.HandlerFunc {
	return func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		input := &s3.GetObjectInput{
			Bucket: &bucket,
			Key:    &key,
		}
		output, err := s3Client.GetObject(context.Background(), input)
		if err != nil {
			http.Error(w, "failed to get object", http.StatusInternalServerError)
			return
		}
		defer output.Body.Close()
		w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/octet-stream")
		w.Header().Set("Content-Disposition", "attachment")
		io.Copy(w, output.Body)
		log.Println("downloaded full object")
	}
}
